title: Technical Engineering Manager - Salesforce
jobDescription:
Job Description: Salesforce Engineering Manager

We are seeking a Salesforce Engineering Manager to lead distributed engineering teams and drive delivery of complex projects across Salesforce CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud. This role requires strong leadership, technical depth in Salesforce implementations, and the ability to align cross‑functional teams to deliver scalable, high‑quality solutions. Engineering Manager Responsibilities include researching and developing new products, building projects and overseeing the successful execution of projects throughout the year. Ultimately, you will work closely with different teams to ensure projects are completed according to schedule and budget.

Responsibilities

  • Hire, build, and manage globally distributed Salesforce engineering teams.

  • Plan and execute long‑term strategies for Salesforce CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud implementations.

  • Understand and improve engineering KPIs, with a focus on Salesforce platform performance and scalability.

  • Lead and drive significant results across multiple teams, including:

    • Managing 3+ engineers with direct reports.

    • Overseeing 2+ Salesforce engineering teams focused on CPQ/Billing solutions.

    • Leading business‑critical cross‑functional initiatives involving Sales, Finance, and Product.

  • Conduct managerial interviews and mentor engineering managers in Salesforce hiring practices.

  • Generate and implement process improvements for Salesforce development, testing, and release management.

  • Hold regular 1:1s and skip‑level meetings to foster growth and alignment.

  • Provide management mentorship and career planning guidance.

  • Enable collaboration across Product, Quality, UX, and Finance teams to ensure Salesforce solutions meet business needs.

  • Drive psychological safety and inclusivity across Salesforce engineering teams.

  • Draft quarterly OKRs and Salesforce‑specific KPIs (e.g., CPQ quote accuracy, Billing automation efficiency).

  • Improve product quality, security, and performance within Salesforce implementations.

  • Identify training needs and talent development opportunities in Salesforce CPQ/Billing.

  • Lead R&D projects to explore new Salesforce features and integrations.

  • Collaborate with Sales and Finance stakeholders to design scalable quoting, billing, and revenue recognition processes.

  • Propose budgets and resource plans for Salesforce programs.

  • Create reports and dashboards to provide project updates.

  • Attend Salesforce workshops, conferences, and training sessions.

  • Train new employees on Salesforce onboarding and development practices.

  • Support personal growth of team members, aligning ambitions with organizational Salesforce goals.

  • Generate Salesforce roadmaps and provide long‑term vision for CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud adoption.

Requirements and Skills

  • Proven experience as an Engineering Manager or Salesforce leader managing distributed teams.

  • Hands‑on expertise in Salesforce CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud.

  • Strong analytical skills for evaluating Salesforce data and solving complex implementation challenges.

  • Excellent communication skills for cross‑functional collaboration with Sales, Finance, and Product teams.

  • Detail‑oriented with ability to identify critical Salesforce issues impacting revenue processes.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

  • Strong problem‑solving abilities in Salesforce architecture and integrations.

  • Ability to collaborate with geographically dispersed teams.

  • Interpersonal skills to navigate challenging Salesforce implementations and deliver customer‑ready solutions.

  • Experience hiring, coaching, and mentoring Salesforce engineers and managers.

  • Ability to make effective, timely decisions in fast‑paced Salesforce project environments.

  • Interpersonal skills to successfully navigate challenging situations and effectively deliver products to end customers

  • Ability to hire, coach, and mentor engineers and fellow managers on a continuous basis

title: Market Development Manager MEP
jobDescription:
Lead the Next Wave of Construction Tech as a Market Development Manager - MEP (Stabicad)

Are you an entrepreneurial market builder ready to launch and scale a global leading software in an untapped, greenfield territory? Trimble is looking for a strategic business leader to roll out the "India MEP Strategy" for Stabicad—our premier MEP design and detailing software that runs natively on Autodesk Revit. If you are comfortable navigating ambiguity, driving technical strategy, and treating a territory like your own business, this is your chance to build a foundation for long-term market dominance.

About Us:

Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com

Our Portfolio & The Opportunity: While Trimble has an incredibly strong, established footprint in India with our structural portfolio (Tekla), the Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) sector represents a massive, untapped opportunity. Stabicad enables MEP modelers to create constructible 3D models with unmatched productivity, and you will lead the charge in establishing its footprint.

What Makes This Role Great:

In this role, you will be the absolute business leader for the Indian MEP territory, serving as the strategic bridge between global product teams and local market needs. You will partner with a dedicated technical Sales Engineer to validate product-market fit, map the "Right to Win," and secure the initial wave of high-profile customer references. Operating at a high level of executive visibility, your impact will be immediate and measurable as you transform top-tier firms into "raving fans" of our ecosystem.

Key Exciting Responsibilities

  • Own the Success of Stabicad in India: Act as the primary business owner for the product line, driving product feedback, market-fit validation, commercial sales, and localized country strategy to support long-term revenue goals.

  • Market Strategy & Product Intelligence: Serve as the "eyes and ears" in the field. Sharpen sector deep-dives across MEP consultancies, BIM chapters, and general contractors, delivering direct feedback to global Product Management regarding essential local standards and content libraries.

  • Strategic Business Development: Hunt and secure net-new, MEP-focused accounts. Move conversations with C-level executives and directors at tier-1 firms from basic features to core business outcomes (pre-fabrication, risk reduction, and detailing efficiency).

  • Ecosystem & Partnership Architecture: Identify, align, and partner with key Indian industry organizations, BIM institutions, and manufacturing bodies to position Stabicad as the definitive market thought leader.

  • Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Guide the everyday focus of your technical Sales Engineer to align demos with strategic value, while collaborating with the Tekla sales team to unlock cross-sell opportunities within large general contractors.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Industry Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of professional experience within the Construction/MEP industry or the Construction Tech software marketplace in India.

  • Revit & BIM Ecosystem Fluency: Strong fundamental understanding of the Autodesk Revit ecosystem; you must clearly understand the operational differences between design, detailing, and fabrication workflows.

  • Strategic Hunter Mindset: A proven track record of successfully entering new regional markets or launching net-new products, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and build pipelines from scratch.

  • Core Competencies: Entrepreneurial drive to treat the territory like a private business, proactive problem-solving, and the technical savvy to translate localized industry needs into formal product business cases.

Bonus Points For:

  • Established professional connections or prior experience working alongside relevant Indian industry associations and consulting bodies.

  • An active, robust network of C-level and director-level contacts within the Indian MEP and construction contractor ecosystem.

Logistics:

  • Location: Navi Mumbai, India

  • Job Type: Full-Time

jobDescription:
Empower Structural Innovation as a Technical Support Professional – Tekla Structures (Concrete, Precast, & Rebar)

Are you a customer-focused structural professional who loves deconstructing complex software challenges? Trimble is seeking a high-caliber Technical Support Professional to join our dedicated Customer Support network. In this high-impact position, you will serve as the premier point of contact for enterprise clients navigating advanced workflows within Tekla Structures, specifically focusing on the Concrete, Precast, and Rebar modules. Your immediate technical expertise will ensure engineering and detailing teams around the world minimize downtime and achieve structural precision.

Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com

Our Product Ecosystem: Tekla software solutions are the global standard for advanced Building Information Modeling (BIM) and structural engineering. From massive cast-in-place concrete structures to complex precast components and high-density reinforcement detailing, Tekla drives structural lifecycle efficiency from design to the job site.

What Makes This Role Great:

In this role, you will transition from a day-to-day detailer or modeller into a highly valued structural subject matter expert. Operating within our state-of-the-art hubs in Chennai or Navi Mumbai, you will have the technical autonomy to reverse-engineer software anomalies, troubleshoot localized configurations, and configure cross-platform cloud integrations. You will work closely with global helpdesks and act as a crucial voice-of-the-customer, directly collaborating with Trimble’s Product Development teams to advocate for product updates and eliminate architectural bottlenecks.

Key Exciting Responsibilities

  • Complex Modeling Resolution: Provide clear, step-by-step technical guidance to resolve advanced structural modeling and parametric geometry issues faced by global engineering accounts.

  • Database & Catalog Orchestration: Manage, audit, and troubleshoot intricate software databases, custom reinforcement catalogs, and automated Bar Bending Schedules (BBS).

  • Deliverable Configuration Support: Assist detailers in configuring and optimizing General Arrangement (GA) drawings, Cast Unit drawings, automated rebar schedules, and custom Template Editor (.tpl) reports.

  • Environment Architecture Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve localized company environment bugs, including custom parametric components, complex drawing layouts, custom attributes, and enterprise firm/project folder paths.

  • Cloud & Interoperability Engineering: Support collaborative cloud workspaces by resolving interoperability bottlenecks across Trimble Connect, Tekla Model Sharing, and open BIM data exchanges (IFC, DWG, DXF, BVBS).

  • Bug Replication & Product Escalation: Systematically replicate user-reported software errors, document system limitations, and escalate unresolved code defects to global development teams while populating internal knowledge bases.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Professional Experience: 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience utilizing or supporting Tekla Structures. Highly preferred experience operating within an RCC, Precast detailing, or high-fidelity BIM production environment.

  • Technical Deep-Dive Mastery: Complete mastery of Tekla Structures software functionality, system configurations, directory folders, detailing standards, and reinforcement modules.

  • Diagnostic Capabilities: Strong analytical and diagnostic skills with a proven capability to investigate system logs, reverse-engineer software errors, and troubleshoot severe system crashes under pressure.

  • Communication & Deadline Focus: Exceptional, patient, and highly professional written and verbal communication skills to deliver technical solutions clearly to users working under strict engineering deadlines.

  • EDUCATION: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.

Bonus Points For:

  • Workflow Automation Tooling: Practical knowledge or script exposure to Tekla Open API, C#, or Grasshopper for parametric workflow automation.

  • Advanced Component Customization: Direct experience developing complex parametric Custom Components and custom software macros.

  • Cross-Domain Competency: Prior structural background or foundational workflow knowledge in structural steel detailing and fabrication logic.

Closely collaborate with global and regional marketing teams to adapt campaigns for local relevance.
  • Field Marketing & Events: Design and execute a localized events strategy, including executive roundtables, tradeshows, and Trimble-hosted events, to build pipeline, brand awareness and thought leadership.
  • Digital & Performance Marketing: Implement and report on performance marketing across digital platforms that work best in India like Linked In, PPC, software review sites and any other platforms best suited to India, collaborating with a global paid media team to drive high-intent opportunities.
  • Strategic Local Partnerships: Own and drive relations and initiatives with key local industry bodies, associations, advisories, and technology alliances to expand market reach.
  • People Management: Mentor and coach a high-performing, data-driven marketing team while managing external agencies and contractors
  • Content & Localization: Create and manage India-specific content and messaging that resonates with local audiences while ensuring alignment with Trimble’s global brand story.
  • PR & Awareness: Work with internal stakeholders and external agencies to increase Trimble’s share of voice and brand recognition in India.

  • Experience: Minimum 12 years of B2B marketing experience in India, ideally within high-growth Saa S or technology organizations (CAD/CAM/BIM industry or construction technology experience would be a big plus!)

  • Domain Expertise: Data-backed, proven track record in demand generation, field marketing, digital marketing, event management, and integrated campaigns.

You will interface directly with stakeholders, product teams, and end-users, quickly becoming the ultimate product expert while driving automation and optimization strategies across our deployment pipeline.

  • Deployment Planning & Coordination: Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to plan deployment activities. Develop deployment strategies, timelines, and resource requirements while coordinating across groups to ensure smooth execution.

  • Technical Architecture & Guidance: Understand the technical deep-dive aspects of deployed systems or software. Provide ongoing guidance and support to teams involved in the deployment process while identifying technical risks and proposing workarounds.

  • User Support & Training: Assist end-users in understanding and utilizing the deployed software. Provide training sessions to familiarize users with new functionalities, address user queries, and provide timely, high-quality resolutions.

  • Documentation & Progress Tracking: Create and maintain comprehensive deployment documentation, including procedures, user guides, and troubleshooting resources. Prepare deployment progress reports and track issues for future reference.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to optimize the deployment process and enhance efficiency. Propose and implement process improvements, automation workflows, or tools to systematically streamline deployments.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Education & Background: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, combined with proven experience in deployment support, software implementation, or a similar role.

  • Cloud Platform Mastery: Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or similar providers, including compute, storage, networking, databases, and deployment models (Iaa S, Paa S, Saa S).

  • Systems Administration & Networking: Proficient in system administration tasks (server provisioning, configuration management, and troubleshooting) and networking concepts (IP addressing, subnets, routing, load balancing, firewalls). Familiarity with virtualization technologies like VMWare, Hyper-V, or KVM.

  • Cloud Security Infrastructure: Solid understanding of cloud security best practices, including identity and access management (IAM), encryption, network security groups, and data protection.

  • Professional Competence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, active listening capabilities, a highly organized and self-directed approach to problem-solving, and the ability to maintain absolute professionalism, discretion, and accuracy.

Bonus Points For:

  • Automation Capabilities: High proficiency in scripting languages like Python, Bash, or Power Shell for automation scripting and system integration.

  • Cross-Functional Domain Knowledge: Foundational understanding of Business Accounting (analyzing financial statements, invoice processing in accounts payable/receivable) and basics of Payroll Management.

  • Product Knowledge: Ability to quickly develop and maintain a high level of knowledge of Viewpoint software products and remain an expert from both an internal and user perspective.
